definitions: A city and commune in the south of France, in the Bouches-du-Rhône department.
Historically known for its Roman and Romanesque monuments, including an amphitheatre and a theatre.
A place famously depicted in paintings by Vincent van Gogh.
examples: Van Gogh painted many scenes in Arles.
The Roman arena in Arles is a major tourist attraction.
She spent her vacation exploring Arles.
